Resolves #19988

Filters unmounted overflow items (`hidden && hideMode !== 'visibility'` or `vdom.removeDom: true`) out of `Neo.draggable.container.SortZone#onDragStart`'s active `sortableItems` snapshot via `SortZone#getSortableItems`, while preserving `getDraggableItems` for `.neo-draggable` wrapper-class marking. Without this filter, overflow-withheld tab header buttons return `{x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0}` from `owner.getDomRect`, which `adjustItemRectsToParent` shifts to `(-ownerRect.x, -ownerRect.y)` and `switchItems` writes onto visible buttons (`left: (-ownerRect.x - width)px, top: (-ownerRect.y)px` → viewport `(-180, 0)`). Also adds `Neo.dashboard.dock.interaction.TabSortZone#resolveDraggedItemId` so dock gesture payloads resolve `dockItemIds` through the dragged button's index in `owner.getTabButtons()` rather than `startIndex` in the filtered `sortableItems` subset.

Evidence: L3 (local headless Chromium whitebox E2E + unit suites) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-4).

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline unit + e2e specs ran (`change-class: restoration`).

| AC-2 | `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationTabDragHeadersStayNL.spec.mjs` (verifies `inlinePosition === ''`, `inlineLeft === ''`, `inlineTop === ''`, `computedPos !== 'absolute'`, and `verifyComponentConsistency` after drop) |
| AC-3 | `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationTabDragHeadersStayNL.spec.mjs` (2200×1000 viewport, 3rd visible tab of `heavy-tabs` dragged 120 px right, 45 px rise above the strip, and back down; joined the hosted Workstation E2E tier) |
| AC-4 | `test/playwright/unit/draggable/container/SortZone.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockTabSortZone.spec.mjs`, and `test/playwright/unit/tab/plugin/Overflow.spec.mjs` (123/123 passing) |

## Deltas from ticket
- Added `Neo.dashboard.dock.interaction.TabSortZone#resolveDraggedItemId` alongside `SortZone#getSortableItems` so that when `Overflow#computeOverflow` withholds an earlier tab before the dragged tab, `TabSortZone` maps the dragged button via `owner.getTabButtons().indexOf(dragComponent)` instead of indexing `dockItemIds` by the filtered `sortableItems` `startIndex`.
